    crypto: algif - add AEAD support
    
    This patch adds the AEAD support for AF_ALG.
    
    The implementation is based on algif_skcipher, but contains heavy
    modifications to streamline the interface for AEAD uses.
    
    To use AEAD, the user space consumer has to use the salg_type named

bic_trace_step.reason: In `aead_recvmsg()`, line 215: `aead_request_set_crypt(&ctx->aead_req, sg, ctx->rsgl[0].sg, used, ctx->iv);` uses the socket-wide IV buffer `ctx->iv` directly without making a per-request copy. In `aead_sendmsg()`, line 166: `memcpy(ctx->iv, con.iv->iv, ivsize);` modifies the same `ctx->iv` buffer. This creates a race condition: an asynchronous crypto request may still be in flight when a subsequent `sendmsg` updates the IV, leading to inconsistent IV usage. No per-request copy is made, and the fix is absent in this initial commit.
